text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since declaring war on Orfevre, Win Variation's fighting spirit has been nothing short of extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Looks like I can shave off
a bit more time on the next lap!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: âI'm off!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, could I do one more set?!
It wasn't as tough as I thought, so just a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so arrived the day of the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Ah, o-of... course—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“...... After saying all that,
I really can't afford to run a half-hearted race, can I...?”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The more I think about how hard I have to try...
my, my legs start shaking...!
choice_data_list: You'll be fine! Come on, let's think back.
You'll be fine! Come on, let's think back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To ease her nervousness, I showed her the times she had recorded around her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-It's so... slow. I had no idea it was this slow.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I really am getting stronger, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every race that concludes,
Win Variation grows stronger
and shines brighter and brighter.
choice_data_list: There's nothing to be afraid of. You'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...
Right, that's so true.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Trainer worked this hard alongside me...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Then it's okay.
I know I'll be fine...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—...All together, in conspiracy, is it?
How peculiar.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! Dammit,
I already decided to quit, didn't I...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Was that the Trainer's doing as well?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph—we are both peculiar creatures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Bow your heads and pray.
For my victory.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Orfevre!
I wondered what would happen after the Tenno Sho (Spring),
but... will we witness a comeback story?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm gonna run and set this place on fire!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I've been looking forward to this!
Show 'em your true grit, Bariyarn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst a whirlwind of varied expectations—
the curtain rose on the Takarazuka Kinen!
